name: Carved Floral Centrepiece Bowl
shortDescription: A scalloped decorative bowl with pierced floral and vine carving.
description: A functional work of art for the dining or console table. The scalloped rim is pierced with a continuous floral vine, while the interior carries a carved medallion. Use it as a fruit bowl, a catch-all for keys and trinkets, or simply as a sculptural centrepiece.

faqs.question: Can I serve food in it?
faqs.answer: It is ideal for dry items such as fruit, bread or dry snacks. We recommend a liner for oily foods and avoid soaking it in water.

faqs.question: How do I clean it?
faqs.answer: Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth. Do not immerse in water or place in a dishwasher.

faqs.question: Is the carving all around?
faqs.answer: Yes, the pierced floral pattern runs around the entire rim and body of the bowl.
